sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "muscle_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label_ru" TEXT NOT NULL, "view" TEXT NOT NULL, "region_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_key" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contraindication_tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label_ru" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "instructions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "common_mistakes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "animation_path" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "hide_optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hide_optional" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" INTEGER NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "gender" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_muscles" ("exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "muscle_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES muscle_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "intensity" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "muscle_group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_contraindications" ("exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "contraindication_tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contraindication_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id", "contraindication_tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_contraindications" ("user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "contraindication_tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contraindication_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "contraindication_tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "days_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "program_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_index" INTEGER CHECK (day_index BETWEEN 0 AND 6), "day_of_week" INTEGER CHECK (day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 7));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_day_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES program_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "is_alternative" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_alternative" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "program_day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES program_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "program_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES programs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "program_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_day_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES program_days (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "day_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variant" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_set_results" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "exercise_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_marks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "program_day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES program_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "week_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "neck_cm" REAL NULL, "chest_cm" REAL NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "hips_cm" REAL NULL, "biceps_cm" REAL NULL, "forearm_cm" REAL NULL, "thigh_cm" REAL NULL, "calf_cm" REAL NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_warning_dismissals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "program_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "dismissed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX exercise_muscles_muscle_group_idx ON exercise_muscles (muscle_group_id)
CREATE INDEX exercise_contraindications_tag_idx ON exercise_contraindications (contraindication_tag_id)
CREATE INDEX user_contraindications_tag_idx ON user_contraindications (contraindication_tag_id)
CREATE INDEX program_days_program_idx ON program_days (program_id)
CREATE INDEX program_day_exercises_day_idx ON program_day_exercises (day_id)
CREATE INDEX program_day_exercises_exercise_idx ON program_day_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_reminders_day_idx ON workout_reminders (program_day_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_sessions_program_idx ON workout_sessions (program_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_sessions_day_idx ON workout_sessions (program_day_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_set_results_session_idx ON workout_set_results (session_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_set_results_exercise_idx ON workout_set_results (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX schedule_marks_day_idx ON schedule_marks (program_day_id)
